notes.title: Huge list of features!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As the first update I wanted to address some of the missing content the community (more specifically the reviews) asked for! So here it is the huuge list:


Record tracking and display: On every match you match we will compare the score with your previous record and store that for reference
Day/night mode: If you play for a long time the background sky will start to get darker
Match time count and display: You can now check how long the match is lasting, this information will be useful on a future update
Tutorial: If you have trouble to understand the game mechanics on the start of every match now you can check how everything works
Variable rising speed: to make it more challenging the ladder will present different rising speeds
Levels! Each level increases the rising speed a bit
Fullscreen mode (on/off): For those who enjoys playing on windowed mode too
Exit button: To quickly leave the game
Pause: No need to explain these
Camera shake effects: To make it more "juicy"
Mouse over HUD effects: Improving the UX
New mouse cursor: Easier to see during the match
And much more!


Hope you enjoy! More updates soon!
